title: Scaling Laws
motto: The 2020 Kaplan paper said: bigger model, lower loss. The 2022 Hoffmann paper said: you were under-training. Compute goes into two buckets — parameters and tokens — and the split is not obvious.

steps.title: Core idea
steps.body: The 2020 Kaplan paper said: bigger model, lower loss. The 2022 Hoffmann paper said: you were under-training. Compute goes into two buckets — parameters and tokens — and the split is not obvious.

steps.title: Why this matters
cards: When you have C FLOPs of training compute and want the best model, you face two knobs:

1. **How many parameters (N)?** Bigger model, higher capacity.
2. **How many training tokens (D)?** More data, better use of capacity.

steps.title: The concept
steps.body: Loss scales as power law with compute, params, data (Chinchilla).
